ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx 85% of visible surface) contrasted against low-intensity black/dark-grey perimeter regions and focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity boundary along the trailing edge. Left lobe contains isolated dark circular spots in the medial and distal regions. Right lobe exhibits a high-density, high-contrast mottled dark zone at the distal tip and a vertical dark pigment patch adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a deep vertical indentation relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. The right lobe distal edge shows extreme amplitude variations with deep jagged notches compared to the more moderate serrations of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves originating from the median notch, extending toward the tips with a convex transition on the leading (lower) edge and a complex, irregular trajectory on the trailing (upper) edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular pixel clusters detected. Left lobe shows ~6 distinct focal points. Right lobe distal tip contains a dense constellation of approximately 12-15 dark spots of varying pixel diameters.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) on the right fluke lobe, ranging from the mid-surface to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear rake marks on the right lobe and significant irregular tissue loss/notching at the far right distal trailing edge suggesting past physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density pigmentation 'cap' at the rightmost fluke tip consisting of concentrated dark mottling and spotting.
